justification: Lower the OC-20 DQ-145 ratchet ceiling from 270 to 210 after 60 orphaned council-DCP rows (LE9962_1 = Leichhardt DCP 2013 Appendix D, 33; Chapter_E2_Haberfield_Neighbourhood, 27; no source_council, no precinct, reachable by no address route, same chapters served from council-scoped copies) were withheld live on 2026-10-17 with scripts/withhold_state_paraphrase.py --list data/dcp_orphan_superseded_copies_2026-10-18.json (dry run 60/60/60, applied 60, backup data/db_rollback_backups/withhold_state_pre_2026-10-17T224146_068352.json). Measured by python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-145 = 210; outreach 21/21.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_outreach_claim_checks_oc20.py && python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-20
falsifiable_check.fails_when: DQ-145 exceeds 210, any citation test fails, or the DQ-145 query breaks
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutating the ratchet from <= to < made the at-ceiling test fail (1 failed, 6 passed); restored, 7 passed.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py: constant change only; live run of dq_check.py --outreach read DQ-145 210 and 21/21 after the apply

pre_impl.existing_data: the 61 'no refusal' rows from ce-dq145-270-breakdown-2026-10-17.csv; newer council copies Leichhardt_DCP_2013__appendix_d_waste_template and Inner_West_Ashfield_DCP_2016__chapter_e2_haberfield
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: the 61 were bucketed 'state' only because source_council IS NULL; 60 are council DCP rows the state-law tool skips by design (instrument_for -> None, pinned in tests/test_state_law_proof.py)
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: reuses the reviewed withhold_state_paraphrase.py; adds a data list only

functions.name: unproven_citations_only_fall
functions.input: a live database connection from dq_db.connect, or None when unreachable

values.read_at: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-145 on 2026-10-17 after the apply

break_it.scenario: the database cannot be reached from where the gate runs
break_it.what_happens: the ratchet reports UNKNOWN and the claim is not verified, never PASS

break_it.scenario: probe SQL references a dropped column
break_it.what_happens: the ratchet reports FAIL with the query error in its detail line
jest exits non-zero (no tests found) -> FAIL

break_it.scenario: an orphan row carried a rule the newer copy lacks
break_it.what_happens: withholding would drop it; measured 5-word coverage in the newer copy: 58/60 at 0.83-1.0 (shortfall at control joins), 2 OCR-garbled bin/truck tables at 0.06-0.13; spot-checked C27 -> 163574, C105 -> 163716 live
break_it.how: no address route reaches the orphans, so no served answer changes; backup restores v2_is_actionable

mutation_analysis: Changing <= to < in the ratchet fails test_at_ceiling_passes. Removing the ratchet from CLAIMS fails test_oc20_is_wired_with_all_three_parts.
residual_risk: The badge inventory checks each file, not each citation expression: a component with one badge and a second bare citation passes (Sol, 2026-10-17). Hard-wired checked={false} cards always show the mark. The ceiling must be lowered by hand after each proof pass.

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/dq_check.py --outreach on main prints 21 of 21
